protocol.cleavage_rule: the last residue of the highest-scoring path given that residue 1 is a signal residue (Viterbi with the outside tag forbidden at residue 1); reported only when detection fires
protocol.detection_score: P(any signal tag) = 1 - P(every residue outside) = the signal marginal at residue 1
protocol.early_stopping: negative mean NLL on an inner whole-cluster holdout of the training partitions; patience 10, at most 80 epochs
protocol.label_states: annotated or negative rows only (ADR-0006); unknown and not_applicable dropped
protocol.selection_rule: mean over folds of cleavage accuracy within +-1 residue among true positives with a usable cleavage site; tie-break mean fold detection MCC under nested thresholds; then the earlier grid point
protocol.threshold_rule: the detection score (probability of any signal tag) at which MCC is maximal; fold k is scored with a threshold tuned on the out-of-fold scores of the other validation partitions; the frozen threshold is tuned on all validation rows. The calibrated threshold is tuned the same way on the cross-fitted calibrated scores
